source: store internal/pouw/hardness/ (Track H's pinned H-1T map)
convention:
Pinned vectors for H-1T's forming and chain from Track H's reference (`h1_tagged.h1t_ref`, `h1_tagged.chain`, store
`internal/pouw/hardness/`), with the salt read from raw per-slice words r0..r17 in the honest kernel's convention
(`h1_kernel.h1t_form_xq`): real lane l's sign is bit 15 (l even) or 31 (l odd) of r_(l div 2), set when x2 = -mu; tag
lane 29's (s, m) is r17's bits 31 and 25..23, lane 30's r16's bits 15 and 9..7, lane 31's r16's bits 31 and 25..23, the
sign bit set when v < 0.
